name: short-04-talk-less
notes: BATCH-01 script #26. CONTRARIAN pillar. Hook: specificity. Counter-led structure.

scenes.label: PERCENT
scenes.vo: On the best performing cold calls, the rep talks forty three percent of the time.

scenes.label: MOST REPS
scenes.vo: Most reps talk seventy percent or more.

scenes.text: That gap is the whole job.
scenes.vo: That gap is the whole job.
Talking feels productive. It isn't. Every sentence you add is one they didn't say.

scenes.text: You can't diagnose anything while you're pitching.
scenes.vo: You can't diagnose anything while you're pitching.

scenes.label: THE DRILL
scenes.text: Count to two before you respond. Every time. Out loud in your head.
scenes.vo: Here's the drill. Count to two before you respond. Every single time.

scenes.text: It feels unbearable for about a week.
scenes.vo: It feels unbearable for about a week. Then your close rate moves.
